subject: Q3 Launch Plan: Objectives, Lead Metrics, and Rollout Owners
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 03 Aug 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 Launch Plan: Objectives, Lead Metrics, and Rollout Owners

Team —

Attached is the first draft of the Q3 launch playbook (Q3_playbook_v1.pptx). High level ask: we need alignment on 3 company-level objectives and 1 lead metric per objective, plus explicit rollout owners and a simple contingency plan. I want to collect confirmations or proposed edits by EOD Tuesday (Aug 5) so I can produce the one-page exec summary for the QBR packet.

Key proposals inside the deck (TL;DR):
- Objective A: Improve inference reliability for production workloads (lead metric: infra P95 error rate)
- Objective B: Reduce token cost for common query patterns (lead metric: cost-per-1k tokens on pay-as-you-go)
- Objective C: Expand Dedicated customer base by integrating with marketplace partners (lead metric: closed-won ARR from marketplace trials)

Please:
- Laura — confirm the reliability metric and tolerances (I left tolerances loose in slides 6–8)
- Marissa — propose a customer comms timeline and any GTM dependencies
- Vivek — do you want cadence for go/no-go signoff?

Attachments: Q3_playbook_v1.pptx (presentation)

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Q3_playbook_v1.pptx (presentation)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Aug 2025 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Launch Plan: Objectives, Lead Metrics, and Rollout Owners

Diego — good start, thanks. I reviewed slides 6–8 and have a few edits and clarifications:

- Reliability metric: prefer P95 latency + P95 error rate (two numbers) rather than just error rate. For production SLOs we need both to capture soft failures and slow tails.
- Tolerances: propose sticky thresholds: P95 latency <= 450ms, P95 error rate <= 0.5% for hosted customers; more lenient for Dedicated.
- Measurement cadence: weekly rollups for the QBR, daily alerting for on-call.

I attached a trimmed spreadsheet with suggested measurement queries and sample dashboards (q3_metrics_playbook.xlsx). Also: please add a column in the owners table for "fallback model" (for graceful degradation) — we ran into this in the June outage runbook.

On the timeline: if owners confirm by Aug 5, we have time to prep the customer-facing notes and the QBR one-pager.

-Laura
Director, Reliability Engineering
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: q3_metrics_playbook.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Aug 2025 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Launch Plan: Objectives, Lead Metrics, and Rollout Owners

Diego / Laura —

This looks actionable. A few GTM notes from my side:

- Timeline: recommend a soft launch window Sep 8–15 (internal only), public rollout Sep 22. That gives us two weeks for customer validation and one week for final docs.
- Customer comms: we should prepare a short FAQ + migration notes for Dedicated customers. I'll draft the FAQ and assign copy to Sarah.
- Enablement: request 1 internal walkthrough session for Sales and CS the week of Sep 15.

I've created a shared doc for the comms timeline and dependencies: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Gtm-GTM-timeline

One request: can we standardize the owners table to include "primary owner", "backfill owner", and "customer notify list" columns? I'll add my proposed rows to q3_owners_rollout.csv and push it shortly.

—Marissa
Head of GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 05 Aug 2025 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Launch Plan: Objectives, Lead Metrics, and Rollout Owners

Thanks team — I reviewed the deck and the notes. High level: I approve proceeding to the soft launch plan conditional on two items being addressed by the time we hand the deck to execs:

1) Exec one-pager that summarizes objectives, the 3 lead metrics, and the rollback/contingency plan (single slide / PDF)
2) A conservative contingency budget built into the Q3 forecast (estimate add: $80–120k for scheduled buffer + burst capacity)

If those are in place, go ahead and finalize owners and the comms timeline. I want final sign-off from Diego (product ops) by end of day Aug 6 so we can lock the QBR packet.

Vivek
COO, Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 06 Aug 2025 00:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Q3 Playbook — owners, metrics, and exec summary (sign-off)

All —

Thanks for the rapid responses. Per Vivek's note I prepared a one-page exec summary (q3_exec_summary.pdf) and a finalized owners table (q3_owners_rollout.csv). Marissa added the GTM columns and Laura added the fallback-model column.

I've attached both files and also pushed the final deck to Drive (link below). Key callouts:
- Lead metrics finalized: P95 latency, P95 error rate, cost-per-1k tokens, and closed-won ARR from marketplace trials. Measurement queries are in the metrics workbook.
- Owners table: includes primary/backfill/customer-notify, and a fallback-model field.
- Contingency: added $100k buffer as Vivek requested.

I'm marking this as approved to proceed to the soft launch (internal Sep 8) unless any objection by EOD Aug 6.

External FYI (Katie Ramos, Acme): we will share a targeted customer preview in mid-September — Marissa will follow up with comms and an invite.

Attachments: q3_exec_summary.pdf, q3_owners_rollout.csv

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
